column1: # Stock phrasing in LLM-written docs. One pattern per line, tab-separated:
# The regex is bash ERE, matched against the lower-cased line, so write it in
# lower case. Word edges: (^|[^a-z]) … ([^a-z]|$) — the scanner trims them from
# the excerpt. Adapted from the pattern list in human-speak (MIT,
# github.com/nateherkai/human-speak); not copied. Lines starting with # are skipped.

column3: Start with what the thing does.
Drop the announcement; give the content.
Cut it; start the next sentence.
Replace with the measured fact, or delete.
Say what makes it so, or delete.
Say what the reader can now do.
Delete the hedge; state the point.
Cut the recap; the reader just read it.
